analysis:
## Technical analysis

### Session overview — closed at the day high after +29.95% session

SK Hynix (000660.KS) closed at ₩1,718,000 on 2026-07-31, up ₩396,000 / +29.95% from the July 30 close of ₩1,322,000. Day range: ₩1,586,000 (open = intraday low) to ₩1,718,000 (close = intraday high). The close at the day high on a 29.95% session is one of the most bullish price-action signals for a large-cap stock — it indicates buyers were in complete control for the entire session with no late-day distribution.

### Context: post-earnings thesis validation

The two-day post-earnings selloff (July 29: −9.61%, July 30: −5.64%; cumulative: −14.7% from ₩1,550,000 to ₩1,322,000) created a fundamental discount that the US ADR market identified first: on July 30, SKHY surged +16.9% to $146.65 while the KRX continued to sell off, creating a 60% ADR premium over KRX-implied value (~$92). Today the KRX re-priced to close that gap: KRX +29.95%, SKHY US ADR +17% to ~$149. The ADR premium has compressed from 60% to ~20%.

Key numbers that drove the re-rating:
- Q2 2026 EPS: ₩131.48K (actual) vs ₩71.21K (estimate) = +84.63% beat
- Operating margin: 76% (highest ever recorded by any semiconductor company)
- HBM4 mass production confirmed; 10 multi-year customer supply agreements
- Revenue miss (₩79.32T vs ₩84.12T) entirely attributable to HBM4 shipment timing deferred to H2

### Trend — overreaction resolved; recovering toward framework gate

The post-earnings technical picture has reversed completely in two sessions. The double bottom formed at ₩1,287,000 (July 29 intraday) and ₩1,322,000 (July 30 close) has been confirmed — price has now gapped through all prior resistance levels (₩1,450,000, ₩1,550,000 pre-earnings) in a single session.

### Volume — heavy; confirms institutional commitment

Volume estimated well above the 3-month average for a +29.95% session. The sustained buying from open to close (₩1,586,000 → ₩1,718,000, never pulling back to the open) indicates institutional rather than retail buying — retail typically creates a volatile intraday pattern, while institutional accumulation produces steady price appreciation. The close at the day high confirms no late-session institutional selling.

### Strongest support — ₩1,586,000 (today's open/intraday low)

Buyers entered at the open (₩1,586,000) and sustained buying through the close. This level becomes the first support for Monday's KRX open. Institutional traders who bought at the open will defend this level. A Monday gap below ₩1,586,000 on the open would be the first signal that the +29.95% session was a one-day spike rather than a sustained reversal.

### Strongest resistance — ₩1,867,213 (framework gate)

The framework gate remains the primary medium-term resistance level. It is 8.7% above today's close — achievable within 2–3 positive sessions. It represents the pre-established framework entry threshold that was set during the July 2026 SK Hynix analysis period. Clearing the framework gate on a reference close would signal that the post-earnings recovery is complete and the forward HBM4 ramp is fully priced.

### What invalidates the bull read

A KRX close below ₩1,550,000 (pre-earnings reference) would signal that today's +29.95% move was a squeeze rather than a genuine re-rating. A close below ₩1,322,000 (July 30 trough) would invalidate the double-bottom and re-open the post-earnings selloff thesis. Neither is likely given Amazon AWS +36.7% and the Samsung shortage warning fresh in the market, but both serve as hard invalidation levels.
